Class Event.Builder

java.lang.Object
com.cab302.vic.model.Event.Builder
Enclosing class:
Event
public static final class Event.Builder extends Object
Builds an Event with named steps instead of a long positional constructor (Builder pattern).

Optional text fields default to an empty string rather than null, so the rest of the app never has to null-check them. A title and a date are required; build() refuses to create an event without them.
